relationships.title: Urban Power Supply
relationships.description: The Power Grid energizes Skyscrapers, delivering electricity to thousands of offices, apartments, and businesses.

relationships.title: Transit Hub
relationships.description: The Metro connects to Train Stations, creating an integrated public transportation network across the city.

relationships.title: Transportation Network
relationships.description: Bridges extend Highways across rivers and valleys, enabling continuous flow of traffic through the city.

relationships.title: Critical Infrastructure
relationships.description: Water Towers supply Hospitals with clean water, ensuring medical facilities can operate during emergencies.

relationships.title: Public Spaces
relationships.description: Urban Parks complement Public Plazas, providing green spaces and gathering areas for community life.

relationships.title: Renewable Energy
relationships.description: Solar Farms feed into the Power Grid, providing clean renewable energy to reduce the city's carbon footprint.

relationships.title: Commuter Transport
relationships.description: The Metro serves the Business District, transporting thousands of workers daily to offices and commercial centers.

relationships.title: Maritime Gateway
relationships.description: Ports are accessed by Bridges, connecting shipping terminals to the city's road network for cargo distribution.

relationships.title: Event Access
relationships.description: Stadiums are connected by Metro lines, allowing thousands of fans to attend events without traffic congestion.

relationships.title: Cultural Center
relationships.description: Libraries often face Public Plazas, creating cultural centers where knowledge and community intersect.

relationships.title: Urban Skyline
relationships.description: Skyscrapers define the Business District, creating the iconic skyline that represents the city's economic power.

relationships.title: Cargo Route
relationships.description: Highways link Ports to inland destinations, forming the arteries of commerce that move goods across regions.

relationships.title: Transit-Oriented Development
relationships.description: Train Stations anchor Business Districts, with high-density development clustering around major transit hubs.

relationships.title: Green Infrastructure
relationships.description: Urban Parks are irrigated by Water Tower systems, maintaining green spaces even during dry seasons.

relationships.title: Emergency Access
relationships.description: Hospitals are accessible via Metro, ensuring patients and medical staff can reach facilities quickly.

relationships.title: Green Building
relationships.description: Solar Panels power modern Skyscrapers, with rooftop installations reducing reliance on the grid.

relationships.title: Urban Gathering
relationships.description: Public Plazas are served by Metro stations, making them accessible hubs for events and daily life.

relationships.title: Rail Infrastructure
relationships.description: Bridges support Train Stations by carrying rail lines across obstacles, connecting distant neighborhoods.

relationships.title: Industrial Energy
relationships.description: Ports are powered by the Power Grid, running massive cranes and refrigeration systems for cargo handling.

relationships.title: Recreation Zone
relationships.description: Stadiums are often adjacent to Parks, creating recreation zones that serve both athletes and families.
